Vampiric Desires
By: Butterfly's Dust

1000 years ago…

The Vampire Council

"Lord Saeth! The humans are slowly dying, soon we would run out of food and eventually our race will slowly die off…We have to do something!"

"I know what is happening in the world, but we can do nothing except wait…until the time comes when this era ends and a new era begins…until we become so powerful that the humans cower in fear of us…and until only the strongest lives!"

1000 years later…3050

Ice Halls – Assassination Headquarter

Pandora walked through the halls until she came upon an ivory door with carvings of the Ice Goddess. She knocked three times and waited. A maid opened the door and Pandora stepped in and sat down across from Shiva. "Shiva, I heard there's a new mission." Shiva sat in front of her desk looking at the file that had just come in. Pondering whether she wanted to give it to her best friend and top assassin, Pandora. "Here's the file, see if you're willing to take it…" As Pandora was looking through the files Shiva had a worried look on her face. "I'll take it." Pandora walked to the fire and burned the file…after all she was trained to memorize everything no matter how long it was. Shiva wanted to tell her how dangerous it might be but decided not to…after all she should have faith in her best friend...they grew up together and Pandora was always there for her no matter what crazy idea she had in mind so she should do the same for her."Shiva, I know how dangerous it is, after all it is a 2000 year old vampire but if I don't go, someone else will and you know I never give up a challenge. Wish me luck! Bye!" Pandora walked out the door before Shiva can say anything. Pandora walked down to the weapons room and scanned her fingerprint. As she was walking through the weapons, deciding what to choose, she saw Ivory by the whips.

"Hey Ivory! What's up?"

"Nothing…I heard that you took the new mission…"

"Yeah…I did... it's a great challenge for me."

"Yeah…and I know you never give up on a challenge…"

"Of course. So you must have a new mission too since you're here choosing a weapon."

"Yeah…going after this vampire killer who really pisses me off for killing little girls"

Ivory picked up one of the whips and decided she'll use this one.

"Wish you good luck Pandora. See you when I come back."

"Good luck to you too."

Pandora decided to choose a whip, two guns, two short swords made of silver, and a few little darts. She went back to her room. She took a shower and decided to look hot tonight since she was going to go to a club anyway. She went through her wardrobe and took out her leather tank top with a skull on it. Then she went to her drawers and picked out a leather skirt. She decided to wear boots so she can hide the short knives in them and attached the guns to the gun holders under her skirt. She took the whip and curled it so that it fits in her purse. The little darts went into the little holes designed in the bracelet so on the outside it looks like a piece of ordinary jewelry but in truth it's a weapon.

She walked out of her room and into the garage where all the cars are kept. She got into her Red Lamborghini and drove off to Exotic Pleasures.
